quest.title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: The Wonders of Adeptal Amber
quest.description: You agreed to Ioroi's request to "bring Kichiboushi out to train." You'll try taking him to see the places where the adepti live this time. Perhaps Mt. Hulao might be a decent choice...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello— Mountain Shaper—!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Hello— Mon-Mon—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Argh, seems like the adeptus isn't at home...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's not be impolite to the adepti, now.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Paimon, what are adepti?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... They're very special people... Or very special animals?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Like Kichiboushi?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, not exactly! They have mystical powers...

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: They can "kapow"? Then, Kichiboushi also adeptus.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, adepti are much more ancient, and they have a certain... Prestige? Dignity?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Oh. Then Kichiboushi, not adeptus. Ioroi is adeptus!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, this is pretty hard to explain.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The adepti are ancient powers who defend Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Kichiboushi understands. Ioroi protects Chinju Forest, so not adeptus.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's pretty sure that's not how it works, but if it clears up any misunderstandings...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But since we've got this adeptus' abode in front of us, let's take a picture of Kichiboushi right here!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm! Kichiboushi, pose for picture!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good Kichiboushi!

talks.objective: Go to the adeptal abode on Mt. Hulao

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That was a great shot!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mmhaha! Kichiboushi, handsome!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This kid's got zero humility...

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Ooh. Paimon, adepti use what magic?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The adepti are super powerful. For example...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's start with the amber around here.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: What is amber?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon remembers this one. Mountain Shaper has flowers that can create amber to trap bad things that invade his land inside them.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mon-Mon, very powerful. Defends Liyue by trapping bad things.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Long ago, the very, very bad Four Oni of Ogata came into the forest and bullied many bake-danuki. Ioroi transformed into an official, gave them bake-danuki food to eat.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Later, Ioroi and Otogi King threw them into paper and sealed them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, so there's that sort of story too. No wonder Ioroi panicked when he saw that picture of Kichiboushi.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Ioroi is not adeptus, not defending Liyue. But Ioroi protects the forest. He protects tanuki.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Different people have different things they need to defend.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You'll figure it out once you're older, Kichiboushi.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's why you've gotta train hard and become a super strong bake-danuki!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm! Of course! The world-famous bake-danuki, Kichiboushi!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's really curious to know what Ioroi used to look like before he was sealed. He was probably a ball of fun!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon's suddenly reminded of those Treasure Hoarders who were trapped in amber...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They even took us for adepti messengers...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That feels like it was so long ago now. But at the same time, it wasn't, right?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahem. Well, when we came to Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #"The Rite of Descension only happens once a year! Ahaha, I, {NICKNAME}, am gonna have all that delicious food! Come on, Paimon, let's go!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "And all the offerings, too! Paimon's flying over there right now!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Best we stop misrepresenting events...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, okay...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You explain what happened in Liyue in simpler terms.\nYou stop at the point where you went to seek the adepti out in Minlin.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #...As for what happened next, {NICKNAME} and Paimon went to that Liuli Pavilion place we were at earlier.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mon-Mon and Clow-Clow, very powerful! They built a moving house!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Clow-Cl— Cloud Retainer really loves gourmet food as well! We had to make lots of delicious stuff before we could meet with her.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Greedy, like Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Is Paimon adeptus? Paimon is very powerful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, this is kinda complicated. That was praise, sure, but Paimon doesn't feel so good about it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But either way, Paimon isn't an adeptus!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Want to play with adepti!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The adepti don't generally appear before people. But we can have a look around. It's pretty nice here.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Kichiboushi, go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thank goodness we found you! Are you alright, Kichiboushi?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: *whimpers*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, it's okay. But don't run off by yourself next time, alright?

choices.text: You're like his big sister, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's older than Kichiboushi. Of course Paimon's the big sister!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Though I could hardly tell...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: #Mm-mm! Thank you, {NICKNAME}. Thank you, Paimon.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Kichiboushi, almost sealed! Very scary. But Paimon calling Kichiboushi, so not so scary.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, right, Ioroi did say that some smaller tanuki were also sealed...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Inside amber, very scary. Dark, cannot see. Cannot talk. Cannot move. Cannot "kapow"! Like becoming stone.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Ioroi is stone, but still very powerful. Can talk, can see. But cannot move.

choices.text: Would you like to help Ioroi, Kichiboushi?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm. Then, help other stone tanuki too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we're here with you right now, Kichiboushi. We won't let you be sealed!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Yey!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you mustn't be too naughty, either!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm. Yes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's a good boy! Shall we stop here for now? You must need some rest too, Kichiboushi.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Not tired!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, isn't this a pickle. If Kichiboushi won't be good, then Paimon doesn't know where we should go next...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Kichiboushi begrudgingly admits to being tired...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Phew! Kichiboushi really is like a child.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And you're getting better at dealing with then, eh, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Maybe that's because Paimon's been traveling with you for so long! Hehe.

choices.text: Oh, treating me like a kid now, are we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no! Haven't we been accompanying kids a lot? You know, like Dusky Ming and Changchang...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's definitely learned a lot from traveling with you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And this time, the lesson is... Bake-danuki and adepti might not get along.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We've got to give our next destination some thought...

choices.text: Hmm, come to think of it, we have had to take care of many children...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! Like Dusky Ming and Changchang...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! With us around, there's no way you'll be sealed, Kichiboushi!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #"Ooh, {NICKNAME}, you've got to eat more. You're still growing! How will you grow unless you eat more?"
